acceptance_criteria: Mandor menu contract matches daily field operations.
Mandor workspace separates routine monitoring from exception handling.
Each menu has clear purpose, permission boundary, and data source.

issues.title: Build Mandor Dashboard for team readiness and daily blockers
scope: Create Dashboard menu showing team attendance, target readiness, output submitted, pending confirmation, correction queue, and closing status.
Use Bagian and Mandor-Operator scope, not global line/shift assumptions.
Keep dashboard summary lightweight with drilldown links to relevant Mandor menus.
acceptance_criteria: Mandor can see today's team readiness and blockers in one screen.
Dashboard distinguishes accepted output, pending correction, and closing blockers.
Progress is team-scoped and never uses the active Operator personal target as Mandor target.

issues.title: Build Mandor Absensi Tim confirmation workspace
scope: Create Absensi Tim menu for confirming employee Masuk/Keluar records.
Support check, check all, and exception status Izin, Sakit, Alpha with notes.
Expose confirmation status for HRD payroll-ready attendance recap.
acceptance_criteria: Mandor can confirm attendance per employee and per team scope.
Check all cannot silently confirm resigned/inactive employees.
Attendance decisions are auditable and visible to HRD summary.

issues.title: Build Mandor Target Harian planning workspace
scope: Create Target Harian menu for assigning target per operator, Bagian, date, and work category.
Show multi-user impact preview before saving all-operator/team targets.
Support edit, active, inactive, and soft delete for target records.
acceptance_criteria: Target harian is set by Mandor or higher, not manually by Operator.
Target changes are scoped to explicit employee/team selection.
Target active list updates immediately after save in real GAS and mock mode.

issues.title: Build Mandor Hasil Operator monitoring workspace
scope: Create Hasil Operator menu for monitoring normal accepted submits and recent output.
Display transaction metadata with employee id/name masked as needed, Bagian, timestamp, OK, Reject, Tandon, and status.
Provide drilldown to correction/approval actions without mixing routine monitoring with conflict queue.
acceptance_criteria: Mandor can see Operator submissions that do not require HITL approval.
Transaction rows are understandable without relying on UUID alone.
Mock mode shares data with Operator submit flow through persistent demo state.

issues.title: Merge Mandor approval conflict and pre-closing correction workflow
scope: Create Approval & Koreksi menu that combines actionable conflict queue, pending records, void, request correction, and pre-closing correction.
Hide final statuses from active queue while preserving audit/history.
Route resolved items to Hasil Operator or Closing Harian status.
acceptance_criteria: Only actionable PENDING and CONFLICT_PENDING cases stay in the active queue.
Approve, reject, request correction, void, and pre-closing correction are append-only and audited.
Resolved items disappear from work queue immediately in GAS and mock mode.

issues.title: Build Mandor Defect Request workflow
scope: Create Defect Request menu for Mandor to propose new defect categories from field findings.
Separate draft/request defect records from final Supervisor/SuperAdmin defect master.
Show request status and feedback from Supervisor verification.
acceptance_criteria: Mandor can propose defects without mutating final DEFECT_CATEGORIES directly.
Supervisor can later approve/reject requests from the QC workspace.
Operator only sees active final defect categories, not unapproved requests.
